truth_layer_classification.optimization_inputs: DERIVED (from frozen canonical feature matrix and HEV/Risk surfaces)
truth_layer_classification.cooling_effects: MODELED (scenario assumptions derived from microclimate literature)
truth_layer_classification.risk_reduction: MODELED (first-order linear response of canonical Risk = H * E * V)

analytical_mesh_boundary.disqualified_cells_policy: All 68 disqualified cells have candidate eligibility C_i_a = 0 for all interventions a; strictly omitted from solver allocation.

green_corridor.name: Urban Green Corridor & Vegetated Buffer
green_corridor.capacity_rule: 0.10 * max(0, cell_area_m2 - green_space_area_m2 - water_body_area_m2 - norm_ndbi * cell_area_m2)

permeable_surfaces.name: Permeable Pavement & Porous Ground Cover
permeable_surfaces.eligibility_predicate: overall_risk_eligibility == True and norm_ndbi > 0.10 and road_length_m > 0

objective.mathematical_expression: sum_{i in Eligible} sum_{a in Catalog} r_{i, a} * q_{i, a}
objective.marginal_risk_reduction_coefficient: r_{i, a} = E_i * ( V_i * (0.25 * e_a / Delta_T_scale) + H_i * (v_a / A_cell_i) )

constraints.name: Total Budget Constraint
constraints.formulation: sum_{i in Eligible} sum_{a in Catalog} (F_a * x_{i, a} + c_a * q_{i, a}) <= Budget_INR
constraints.notes: Budget is a user scenario envelope in 2025 INR.

constraints.name: Semi-Continuous Activation Lower Bound
constraints.formulation: q_min_a * x_{i, a} <= q_{i, a} for all i, a
constraints.notes: Enforces minimum contractor mobilization lot size.

constraints.name: Physical Capacity Upper Bound
constraints.formulation: q_{i, a} <= Q_max_{i, a} * x_{i, a} for all i, a
constraints.notes: Guarantees allocations do not exceed spatial physical bounds.

constraints.name: Candidate Eligibility Bound
constraints.formulation: x_{i, a} <= C_{i, a} for all i, a
constraints.notes: C_{i, a} is binary 0/1 based on spatial morphology and missingness.

constraints.name: Ground Area Mutual Compatibility Constraint
constraints.formulation: q_{i, green_corridor} + q_{i, permeable_surfaces} + q_{i, bioswales} <= A_ground_treatable_i
constraints.notes: Prevents co-located ground interventions from exceeding available surface area.

constraints.name: Rooftop Compatibility Constraint
constraints.notes: Restricted strictly to available building roof footprint.

constraints.name: Integrality and Non-Negativity
constraints.formulation: x_{i, a} in {0, 1}, q_{i, a} >= 0 for all i, a

solver_requirements.standard_form: min c^T y s.t. A_ub y <= b_ub, y_l <= y <= y_u, y_integrality in {0, 1}
solver_requirements.determinism_mandate: Zero random search heuristics; fixed branch-and-bound seed; identical solutions across executions.

edge_cases.zero_budget: Budget = 0.0 returns feasible all-zero vector (total cost = 0.0, risk reduction = 0.0).
edge_cases.budget_insufficient_for_minimum_lot: Returns feasible all-zero vector without crashing.
edge_cases.zero_impact_allocation: Strictly excluded by optimization objective unless required by hard minimum constraints.

provenance_and_governance.ward_dependency: NONE (Operates strictly on H3 Resolution 9 mesh)
